pass1.rule: Unique live-resolved files (model-urls.json, one row per real path) with ≥1200 triangles. Playable hummingbird (1140 tris) is the only exception below that line. Unused x/animals/candidates (deer, rabbit, squirrel) and the non-blocky meadow-guide alternate are skipped even though they are over 1200. Plant LOD0 is the merged mesh in assets-incoming/optimized/models/ when one exists.
pass1.why_not_2k: Only two unique live files exceed 2k tris (both red-flower variants at 2174). The library is already cute blocky low-poly, so a 2k cutoff would produce almost no LODs.

pass2.rule: No 1,200-tri cutoff. Every unique live-loaded file in characters (all GLB skins), flyers (AMBIENT table, including ladybug and beetle crawlers), gardens (species buildings), hazards (hazards.js models), and rivals (per-species home/producer/research, territory markers, scaffold). Skip a model only if LOD1 cannot reach about 70% of LOD0 tris, the LOD file would be larger than LOD0, skinning/clips/nodes break, or QA shows a broken silhouette (holes, lost faces, collapsed body). Moose and walking-bat (batw) skins are primitive stand-ins with no GLB.
pass2.lod1_gate: LOD1 must reach ≤70% of LOD0 triangles to ship (this pass). LOD2 still must reach ≤45%.

phone_first_defaults.hysteresis_note: THREE.LOD has no built-in hysteresis. Wrap the distance test so a level is entered at D and left only when the camera comes back inside D * 0.8, and optionally wait 200–300 ms before committing a switch. The user gets motion sick; a hard pop between LODs should never happen in the same frame as a camera ease.
phone_first_defaults.three_example: lod.addLevel(lod0, 0); lod.addLevel(lod1, d1); lod.addLevel(lod2, d2); // then apply hysteresis in an update wrapper

lite.rule: 0.6 × Normal distances
lite.reason: Lite mode is for weaker phones, so cheaper meshes should engage sooner. 0.6× puts LOD1/LOD2 about 40% closer than Normal, which cuts mid-field vertex cost on rival colonies, ambient flyers and hazard fields without placing the lowest mesh in the player’s face. The hysteresis band stays 20% (enter at D, leave at D×0.8) with the same optional 200–300 ms hold: a closer switch would otherwise fire more often during camera eases, which is worse for motion sickness, not better. Distances are the exact 0.6× of the Normal defaults, kept to one decimal so the rule stays obvious.
